statement: Write a PRD for LabSlot, a phone-friendly web app where students book lab slots, replacing paper booking that causes double-booked slots.
users: Students (book and cancel slots, check availability) and lab staff.
problem: Lab slot booking is done on paper, and slots get double-booked.
constraints: The web app must work on phones
success_measures: 80% of bookings are made without staff help
facts: 80% of bookings are made without staff help
standards: Use only facts from the brief and answers; do not invent numbers, features or dates
